clue.text: Dance a doctor held in Missouri

indicators.note: the words 'held in' say that what comes before is kept inside the state abbreviation

parts.note: MO is the US postal abbreviation for Missouri
MB is Bachelor of Medicine, a doctor's degree

explanation.surface: A physician is detained somewhere in Missouri while dancing.
explanation.definitionFit: The mambo is a Latin American ballroom dance of Cuban origin.

clue.text: Wretched skinflint on island climb

parts.note: a miser is a mean person, a skinflint

indicators.note: in a down clue, climb means the island's name is read upwards

parts.note: Elba is the Mediterranean island of Napoleon's exile

explanation.surface: A miserly man on an island makes an unhappy ascent.
explanation.definitionFit: Miserable means wretched, deeply unhappy.

clue.text: Saw graduate master receiving cricket team

indicators.note: receiving means taking something in, so the team goes inside

parts.note: MA, Master of Arts, is a graduate
a cricket team is an eleven, XI in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A teacher with a degree takes on a cricket side.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Saw' is not the verb or tool but a saying.
explanation.definitionFit: A saw is an old saying, a proverb.

clue.text: Ball causes bad fracture

parts.note: off means bad, as of food gone sour
a break is a fracture

explanation.surface: A ball causes a nasty broken bone.
explanation.definitionFit: An off-break is a cricket delivery spun from the off side towards the batsman.

clue.text: Rescue worker's biography written by escort

parts.note: a life is a written account of someone's history, a biography
a guard is an escort protecting someone

explanation.surface: A lifesaver's memoir has been ghosted by their bodyguard.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's after 'worker' stands for 'is', linking definition to wordplay; 'written by' simply places the escort after the biography.
explanation.definitionFit: A lifeguard is employed at a beach or pool to save swimmers in trouble.

clue.text: Thin heel

definitions.meaning: to tilt, as a ship heels over

explanation.definitionFit: Lean means slim, and to lean is to tilt as a ship heels over.

clue.text: Timid sort to deal with a large number on the river!

parts.note: to field a question is to deal with it
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand
the Ouse is an English river

explanation.surface: A shy person handling a crowd on a riverbank.
explanation.definitionFit: Mice are proverbially timid, and the field mouse is a small woodland rodent.

clue.text: Type received here in ancient Rome

parts.note: got means received
hic is Latin for here

explanation.surface: A kind of thing delivered here in old Rome.
explanation.definitionFit: Gothic is a heavy black-letter typeface.

clue.text: Settle a little charge without right

indicators.note: without in its old sense means outside, so the other letters surround the abbreviation

parts.note: a bit is a little
a rate is a charge or fee

explanation.surface: Agreeing a small fee with no rights.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' reads as 'lacking', but here it means outside.
explanation.definitionFit: To arbitrate is to settle a dispute as a neutral judge.

clue.text: Fear of Democrat concerning publicity …

parts.note: re means concerning, about
an ad is publicity

explanation.surface: A Democrat politician is wary of public exposure.
explanation.definitionFit: Dread is great fear.

clue.text: Instrument provided — the latest thing in the plant

parts.note: sax is short for saxophone, a musical instrument
provided, as in 'provided that', means if
the rage is whatever is currently fashionable

explanation.surface: A saxophone appears, conditionally, as the trendiest item inside a factory.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plant' could suggest a factory, but here it is a botanical plant.
explanation.definitionFit: Saxifrage is a rock-garden flower of the genus Saxifraga.

clue.text: Fare put forward for discussion

definitions.meaning: the food set out for a meal
in British usage, to propose an item at a meeting

explanation.definitionFit: A table can mean the food provided, and to table a motion in Britain is to propose it for debate.

clue.text: Soldiers given target for observation

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British army corps
a mark is something aimed at, a target

explanation.surface: Troops are handed something to aim at for surveillance.
explanation.definitionFit: A comment made in passing is an observation.

clue.text: Confessed to being taken in

definitions.meaning: owned up to something, acknowledged guilt
allowed entry, received, as a patient into hospital

explanation.definitionFit: Someone who owns up has conceded the truth, and a patient received into a ward has been let in.

clue.text: … but this person's notices refer to one's monarch

definitions.note: the clue describes the one whose public notices these are, a person not the notices

parts.note: to advert to something is to refer to it
one is I, and 's is is, so one's gives I and S
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: Following 8, this person's notices mention their sovereign.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis links this clue to 8's publicity; the definition describes the person who puts out notices.
explanation.definitionFit: An advertiser is someone who places notices to sell or announce something.

clue.text: Man accompanied by companions love to exchange caresses

parts.note: Bill is a man's name
accompanied by, as a joining of two things, means and
Co, short for company, a group of companions
love is nil in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: A man and his friends who love to cuddle each other.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bill and Co' is a casual phrase for Bill and his friends.
explanation.definitionFit: Lovers who murmur and kiss like doves are said to bill and coo.

clue.text: An allergy developed in relation to an air passage

definitions.text: in relation to an air passage

indicators.note: developed means worked into a new form, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An allergy that has arisen affecting the airway.
explanation.definitionFit: Laryngeal means relating to the larynx, the windpipe's voice box.

clue.text: Place of retreat backed by Iranian money

indicators.note: backed here means turned back to front, so the currency name is read in reverse

parts.note: the rial is the currency of Iran

explanation.surface: A hideaway funded with Iranian cash.
explanation.definitionFit: A lair is an animal's den, a hidden refuge to retire to.

clue.text: Old settler a traveller embraced at New Year?

indicators.note: New, like a fresh start at a new year, means the letters are freshly arranged

parts.note: a rep is a commercial traveller

explanation.surface: An elderly pioneer is hugged by a travelling man at Hogmanay.
explanation.walkthrough: REP is 'embraced' into the pool with AT and YEAR, and 'New' scrambles all nine letters. The 'settler' settled local rates, a British property tax now abolished, so 'old'.
explanation.definitionFit: A ratepayer paid the old British local rates tax, settling the bill.

clue.text: Fare for some goods transported in east of France

indicators.note: in puts the goods inside the French word

parts.note: est is French for east
cargo is goods being shipped

explanation.surface: Food for a few: merchandise moved around eastern France.
explanation.walkthrough: 'east of France' is not a region but the French word for east.
explanation.definitionFit: Escargot, a snail dish, is a delicacy only some diners enjoy.

clue.text: One of our peers almost abandons the Borders

indicators.note: losing its borders means the word for almost drops its first and last letters

parts.note: almost means nearly

explanation.surface: A British lord nearly walks out on the Scottish Borders region.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The Borders' looks like the Scottish region, but it tells you to remove the outer letters.
explanation.definitionFit: An earl is a rank of the British peerage, between marquess and viscount.

clue.text: Determined quietly to introduce new interests

parts.note: p, piano, is the musical direction for quietly

indicators.note: new tells you to make a new arrangement of the letters of interests

explanation.surface: Someone resolved to quietly bring in fresh hobbies.
explanation.definitionFit: A persistent person keeps going with dogged resolve.

clue.text: Emergency involving councillor on river

parts.note: the Isis is the Thames at Oxford

explanation.surface: A crisis involving a local politician on the river.
explanation.definitionFit: A crisis is a moment of acute danger or emergency.

clue.text: Vessel accommodating popular trio, perhaps, for eighteen years

indicators.note: accommodating means holding within, so the vessel's letters go round the rest

parts.note: MY is motor yacht, a vessel
in means popular or fashionable

indicators.note: perhaps suggests the letters of trio could be arranged another way

explanation.surface: A ship houses a well-liked three-piece band for nearly two decades.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' scrambles the trio; a pop trio is not a band here. Minority as a span of years is the legal term for being under age.
explanation.definitionFit: Minority is the legal period of being under age, up to age eighteen in Britain.

clue.text: Distinctive feature of poem beginning with witty saying

indicators.note: beginning with places the saying ahead of the poem

parts.note: a mot is a witty remark, as in bon mot
If is a famous poem by Rudyard Kipling

explanation.surface: The hallmark of a verse that opens with a quip.
explanation.definitionFit: A motif is a recurring theme or characteristic element.

clue.text: Prisoner returns, carrying everyone's beer

indicators.note: carrying means holding something inside, so one piece sits within the other
returns means the prisoner abbreviation is read backwards

parts.note: POW is a prisoner of war
everyone is all; the 's is just possessive

explanation.surface: A convict comes back, holding a pint for every inmate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returns' turns POW into WOP, which then holds ALL.
explanation.definitionFit: Wallop is British slang for beer, especially mild ale.

clue.text: Lessening of restriction at university

parts.note: a let is a hindrance, as in 'without let or hindrance'
up means in residence at university

explanation.surface: An easing of rules on campus.
explanation.definitionFit: A let-up is a pause or reduction in intensity.

clue.text: A piece cut off the handle of a whip

definitions.meaning: a cutting or trimming, as in a cropped part

explanation.definitionFit: A crop is a cutting, and a riding crop is the short stock of a whip.

clue.text: Lock girl out of room, initially

indicators.note: the girl's name stands outside the next letter, so out of here means wrapped around

parts.note: Tess is a girl's name

indicators.note: initially picks out the first letter of room

explanation.surface: A girl is locked out of her room at the start.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lock' looks like a verb about barring a door; it is a lock of hair.
explanation.definitionFit: A tress is a long lock of hair.

clue.text: Vivacious son popular at first, and with good reason

parts.note: s is the genealogical abbreviation for son

indicators.note: at first takes only the opening letter of popular

parts.note: rightly means with justification, with good reason

explanation.surface: A son was well liked at the start, and justifiably so.
explanation.definitionFit: Sprightly means lively and full of energy.

clue.text: Transparent evidence, when distributed, split firm!

indicators.note: distributed means spread around, so the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Proof that a company has broken up, revealed when shared out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'split' looks like an anagram signal, but it is part of the fodder with 'firm'.
explanation.definitionFit: A filmstrip is a strip of transparencies projected one frame at a time, so it shows photographic evidence.

clue.text: It may provide light for a recording engineer

definitions.meaning: a thin candle or wick used for lighting

explanation.definitionFit: A taper is a slender candle, and jokingly one who tapes things is also one.
